 singapore Police website down due to 'intermittent connectivity' issues
 Members of the public should call the '999' emergency number for urgent police assistance. PHOTO: AsiaOne file PUBLISHED ON November 16, 2026 5:55 AM BY Lim Kewei The Singapore Police Force (SPF) announced on Monday (Nov 16) afternoon that its website is temporarily down.
 In a Facebook post at 12.50pm, the police said it cannot receive reports made via the e-services portal. 
 "The SPF website is currently experiencing intermittent connectivity," SPF stated in its post.
 For urgent police assistance, members of the public should call the '999' emergency number, or the police hotline at 1800 255 0000 for other matters.
 "Thank you for your understanding and patience," it added.
